verses.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.pt: Porque todo sumo sacerdote tomado dentre os homens é constituído a favor dos homens nas coisas concernentes a Deus, para que ofereça dons e sacrifícios pelos pecados,
verses.en_web: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
verses.en_bbe: Every high priest who is taken from among men is given his position to take care of the interests of men in those things which have to do with God, so that he may make offerings for sins.

verses.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.pt: podendo ele compadecer-se devidamente dos ignorantes e errados, porquanto também ele mesmo está rodeado de fraqueza.
verses.en_web: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
verses.en_bbe: He is able to have feeling for those who have no knowledge and for those who are wandering from the true way, because he himself is feeble;

verses.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.pt: E por esta razão deve ele, tanto pelo povo como também por si mesmo, oferecer sacrifício pelos pecados.
verses.en_web: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
verses.en_bbe: And being feeble, he has to make sin-offerings for himself as well as for the people.

verses.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
verses.pt: Ora, ninguém toma para si esta honra, senão quando é chamado por Deus, como o foi Arão.
verses.en_web: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
verses.en_bbe: And no man who is not given authority by God, as Aaron was, takes this honour for himself.

verses.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.pt: assim também Cristo não se glorificou a si mesmo, para se fazer sumo sacerdote, mas o glorificou aquele que lhe disse: Tu és meu Filho, hoje te gerei;
verses.en_web: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
verses.en_bbe: In the same way Christ did not take for himself the glory of being made a high priest, but was given it by him who said, You are my Son, this day I have given you being:

verses.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.pt: como também em outro lugar diz: Tu és sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.en_web: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
verses.en_bbe: As he says in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.pt: O qual nos dias da sua carne, tendo oferecido, com grande clamor e lágrimas, orações e súplicas ao que podia livrar da morte, e tendo sido ouvido por causa da sua reverência,
verses.en_web: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
verses.en_bbe: Who in the days of his flesh, having sent up prayers and requests with strong crying and weeping to him who was able to give him salvation from death, had his prayer answered because of his fear of God.

verses.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.pt: ainda que era Filho, aprendeu a obediência por meio daquilo que sofreu;
verses.en_web: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
verses.en_bbe: And though he was a Son, through the pain which he underwent, the knowledge came to him of what it was to be under God's orders;

verses.en: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.pt: e, tendo sido aperfeiçoado, veio a ser autor de eterna salvação para todos os que lhe obedecem,
verses.en_web: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
verses.en_bbe: And when he had been made complete, he became the giver of eternal salvation to all those who are under his orders;

verses.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.pt: sendo por Deus chamado sumo sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
verses.en_web: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.en_bbe: Being named by God a high priest of the order of Melchizedek.

verses.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.pt: Sobre isso temos muito que dizer, mas de difícil interpretação, porquanto vos tornastes tardios em ouvir.
verses.en_web: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
verses.en_bbe: Of whom we have much to say which it is hard to make clear, because you are slow of hearing.

verses.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.pt: Porque, devendo já ser mestres em razão do tempo, ainda necessitais de que se vos torne a ensinar os princípios elementares dos oráculos de Deus, e vos haveis feito tais que precisais de leite, e não de alimento sólido.
verses.en_web: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
verses.en_bbe: And though by this time it would be right for you to be teachers, you still have need of someone to give you teaching about the first simple rules of God's revelation; you have become like babies who have need of milk, and not of solid food.

verses.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.pt: Ora, qualquer que se alimenta de leite é inexperiente na palavra da justiça, pois é criança;
verses.en_web: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
verses.en_bbe: For everyone who takes milk is without experience of the word of righteousness: he is a child.

verses.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.pt: mas o alimento sólido é para os adultos, os quais têm, pela prática, as faculdades exercitadas para discernir tanto o bem como o mal.
verses.en_web: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
verses.en_bbe: But solid food is for men of full growth, even for those whose senses are trained by use to see what is good and what is evil.
